notes: Identity independently verified from the supplied text: HAL cover citation and publisher article header identify Kevin Vezirian, Elisa Sarda, Laurent Bègue, Pierre-Jean Laine, and Hans IJzerman; Journal of Experimental Social Psychology 117 (2025), 104712; DOI 10.1016/j.jesp.2024.104712. The publisher title specifies independent replications and extension of Zarkadi and Schnall’s (2013) Study 1. This is a full primary article text with numbered methods/results and references, not an abstract-only parse or preregistration. No PDF path was supplied. Target matched by Study 1, polarization outcome, French-speaking computer-user sample, page-4 locator and printed partial eta-squared omnibus result, not by numerical matching or row order. The page-4 analytic plan defines polarization as absolute distance from midpoint 4. Table 3 on page 6 separately presents contrasts C1–C4 with Cohen’s d; these are not substituted for the page-4 omnibus test. N=8602 is explicitly final, not derived from df or group summation. Recruitment N=12,335 is not the analytic N; page 4 reports touchpad N=3110, smartphone N=610, unknown/no-answer N=13, retaining computer users N=8602. The exploratory age/gender model on page 5 has a different sample of 8184 and is not the target. Preserve the printed eta bound < 0.001 and exact p=.06 for the same omnibus test. Authors report inability to reproduce polarization, while pages 4 and 6 qualify Study 1 as a non-direct replication with procedural limitations. Original side is an unassigned placeholder only.
